findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_driver_route · Public sink: book_london_airport_transfer, lookup_booking, amend_booking, cancel_booking, track_driver, get_driver_route · Destructive: london_airport_transfer_quote, book_london_airport_transfer, amend_booking, track_driver.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
